game.title: Portal 2
game.blurb: First-person puzzle game from Valve Software, published by Electronic Arts and Valve, released 2011-04-18. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Shooter, Puzzle. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0): nine single-player chapters and the co-op courses.

chapters.title: Chapters 1 to 3
chapters.summary: The Courtesy Call, The Cold Boot and The Return: waking up, the first tests and the early test chambers.

chapters.title: Chapters 4 to 6
chapters.summary: The Surprise, The Escape and The Fall: breaking out and the gel tests. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Chapters 7 to 9
chapters.summary: The Reunion, The Itch and The Part Where He Kills You, to the end of the story. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Single-Player Secrets and Challenges
chapters.summary: Hidden signals and portraits, chamber doors, monitors, speed runs and rule-breaking in the test chambers.

chapters.title: Co-op: Calibration to Mass and Velocity
chapters.summary: The Calibration Course, Team Building and Mass and Velocity co-op courses, with their challenges.

chapters.title: Co-op: Hard-Light Surfaces to Art Therapy
chapters.summary: Hard-Light Surfaces, Excursion Funnels, Mobility Gels and Art Therapy, and finishing every course.

chapters.title: Co-op Gestures and Teamwork
chapters.summary: Gestures, taunts, hugs, rock-paper-scissors and teaching a new partner.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has "Portal 2" at completion stage 2, and all nine single-player chapter pages are written (Chapter 1: The Courtesy Call about 12,100 characters down to Chapter 9: The Part Where He Kills You about 660; Chapters 5, 7 and 9 are short), plus Co-op campaign and all seven co-op course pages (Calibration Course, Team Building, Mass and Velocity, Hard-Light Surfaces, Excursion Funnels, Mobility Gels, Art Therapy), Gameplay, Controls, Achievements and trophies and Walkthrough. Level Editor is linked but not written. Chapter order follows its contents page; titles are reworded and no text was copied. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4200). The Steam store list has app 620 ("Portal 2"), whose schema returned 51 achievements, none hidden. Only two achievements tie to a chapter in the data: "The Part Where He Kills You" shares Chapter 9's name and "You Made Your Point" names Chapter 8. The other 14 story achievements were split across the three chapter groups by unlock rate (74.0% down to 34.1%), which is our own guess. Test chamber feats (Test Chamber 07 and 10) do not name a chapter and sit in the secrets chapter. "Still Alive" names "Course 4" and was put with the later courses as a guess. half-life.fandom.com answers the API under "Portal 2" with about 99 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
